title: Unicode coverage, fallback and font runs
summary: dev3 separates preferred semantic font choice from actual glyph coverage. planRunsForPurpose returns ordered FontRun objects, the minimal face set used and explicit missing characters instead of silently substituting glyph zero.
invariants: findForPurpose chooses the preferred semantic face; planRunsForPurpose evaluates the actual text corpus.
Fallback faces are introduced only for characters not covered by earlier selected faces.
Coverage-provider suggestions are accepted only after a glyph provider proves a non-zero glyph.
Missing characters remain explicit in FontRunPlan and fullyCovered is false when any scalar is unresolved.
Coverage/run segmentation is not shaping: grapheme clustering, bidi ordering and OpenType GSUB/GPOS belong to a future shaping-service boundary.

provenance.claim: dev3 coverage-aware fallback, FontRun/FontRunPlan semantics, live mixed-script result and shaping boundary.
Semantic selection vs coverage choice and renderer-neutral run-plan boundary.
Family-collapsed fallback matching, coverage-provider acceleration and ordered run construction with explicit missing characters.
